Msg.Desc: "Click the Help button to view the limitations in the lite version of the tool."
"Unable to launch %s because the license server %s cannot be reached. Ensure the CDS_LIC_FILE environment variable is set correctly and points to a working Cadence license server."
"Unable to launch %s. A valid license was not found at the %s license server. Update the license server configuration to include %s licenses."
"Cannot run %s because the Cadence OrCAD installation is set to a Single User License mode and the currently signed in user is not registered for %s or the registration has expired."
"Unable to launch %s because the Single User License cannot be authenticated. Ensure the system is connected to the net and try again."
